_README: LOCAL secrets for the phone-OIDC Worker. Copy this file to secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR own values. Claude reads secrets.json to set the Cloudflare Worker secrets via `wrangler secret put`. NEVER commit secrets.json or share it.
BASE44_APP_ID: <your Base44 app id, the part between /apps/ and /editor/ in the editor URL>
BASE44_API_KEY: <your Base44 app api_key, from the app's Code/SDK snippet>
APP_NAME: <the name to show on the login screen, e.g. My Warehouse App>
_note_generated_secrets: OIDC_CLIENT_ID, OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET and OIDC_PRIVATE_KEY are NOT entered here. They are generated by `npm run keygen` into KEYS.local.json.
